C09-M01-L06-F1.title: Anatomy of a case file
C09-M01-L06-F1.caption: The eight kinds of record that make up one case file, each answering a different reviewer question.
C09-M01-L06-F1.alt: Tree diagram. The root box, Case file KF-2026-031 (one matter, one file), has arrows to eight child boxes: Authorisation and scope (instruction and scope changes); Evidence register (items and derived items); Custody records (receipts and transfer logs); Contemporaneous notes (running first-person account); Examination log (one row per step, tool and version); Decision log (choices, reasons, approvals); Communications record (who was told what, when); Drafts and review (versioned drafts, peer review). A note says a missing record type is a gap a reviewer will notice.

children.label: Examination log
children.sub: one row per step, tool and version

C09-M01-L06-F1.note: Every record type cross-references item numbers; a missing type is a gap a reviewer will notice.

C09-M01-L06-F2.title: The same session, noted weakly and noted well
C09-M01-L06-F2.caption: Five entries from one examination session on the USB working copy, written as a hurried note and as a reviewable note.
C09-M01-L06-F2.alt: Two-column comparison with vs between them. Weak note, red: Looked at the USB image; Opened it, all fine; Found the spreadsheet, he copied it; Some time in the afternoon; Messed up export, redid it. Strong note, green: 14:12 IST verified E02-D1 working-copy hash, match; 14:15 opened in approved viewer, version logged; 14:31 observed pricing_Q1.xlsx in Exports, no inference on who copied it; 14:36 screenshot SS004 of file properties, hashed; 14:40 export X1 saved to wrong folder, kept, X2 saved, both logged. A note says a strong note is timed, specific, repeatable and honest about mistakes.

columns.title: Weak note
items: Found the spreadsheet, he copied it

columns.title: Strong note
items: 14:12 IST Verified E02-D1 working-copy hash: match
14:31 Observed pricing_Q1.xlsx in Exports; no inference on who copied it
14:36 Screenshot SS004 of file properties, hashed
14:40 Export X1 in wrong folder: kept; X2 saved; both logged

C09-M01-L06-F2.note: A strong note is timed, specific, repeatable and honest about mistakes, and it never concludes about a person.
